acceptance: The throughput-uat job uploads ~/Developer/benchmark_runs logs and results with if: always()
The CedarDB cell passes a statement_timeout so a slow query fails individually instead of the cell producing no result
Root cause identified from captured logs and fixed (CedarDB replaces the Postgres cell per owner decision)
continue-on-error removed from both CedarDB steps after at least 3 consecutive green nightly CedarDB cells; GitHub issue #2571 closed or retitled
context: Diagnostics and fix landed in #2672 (merged 2026-10-05). An engine spike on the ubuntu runner (run 37336218577) showed unindexed PostgreSQL cannot finish TPC-H SF1 inside the cell: Q17 and Q20 hit the 600 s statement timeout, and the 64 MB /dev/shm breaks Q4 and Q21. The owner chose CedarDB, pinned by digest, for the nightly throughput cell. The quarantine (continue-on-error on the CedarDB sweep and assert steps, issue #2571) stays until 3 consecutive green nightly cells. Green nights so far: 2026-10-06 (run 37462397762). Remaining: remove the quarantine in the floor-activation PR, and rewrite this item's acceptance for the CedarDB cell when closing it.
description:
`.github/workflows/nightly.yml:1038` and `:1119` set `continue-on-error: true` on the Postgres throughput sweep and assert steps (quarantine for GitHub issue #2571, added in #2572). The sweep failed in all 10 nightlies from 09-25 to 10-04, hitting the 2400 s cell cap with no result JSON. Raising the timeout in #2384 changed nothing. The per-stream INDEPENDENT_CONNECTION path that PostgreSQL uses therefore has no working nightly check.

The failure cannot be diagnosed from CI. The throughput-uat job (nightly.yml:964-1155) has no upload-artifact step. The verbose re-run is skipped on timeout (tests/uat/runner.py:393). PostgreSQL statement_timeout defaults to 0 (postgresql.py:239,403), and the UAT options set only the username.

Likely cause, unverified: one runaway query (TPC-H Q17 or Q20, correlated subqueries) on unindexed PostgreSQL at SF1 consumes the whole budget.
